question: What problem can these two state variables cause?
code:
const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
const [isError, setIsError] = useState(false);
options: They can both be true at once
say: What problem can these two state variables cause?
explanation: If you forget to update them together, both can be true, an impossible state. One status variable avoids that.
explainSay: Both can end up true at the same time, an impossible state. Use one status variable instead.
